Dear Mr. Hunt,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above, we acknowledge your claim that the debt is not yours. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt. We will investigate your dispute and verify the ownership of the debt. If we are unable to validate the debt, we will cease collection efforts.

We have reviewed the account information on file, which indicates that the original creditor is Sunrise Health Partners. The current balance on the account is $4,983.73. The charge-off date was March 18, 2023.

We will conduct an investigation into your dispute and provide a written response within 30 days, as required by the FDCPA. If we are unable to validate the debt, we will take the necessary steps to comply with applicable laws and regulations.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is not yours. You may also request that we provide you with a written statement that the debt is disputed.

Sincerely,
